name: curtain_grid_layout
author: hprebar
title: Calculate Curtain Wall U/V Grid Division Offsets
description: Calculate horizontal U-grid line offsets and division counts along host Revit Curtain Walls without modifying the document.
notes: Calculates parametric grid line offset positions along curtain wall baseline curve.

curtainWallElementId.description: Element ID of host Revit Curtain Wall.

uSpacingMeters.description: Horizontal U-axis spacing between vertical mullions in meters.

vSpacingMeters.description: Vertical V-axis spacing between horizontal mullions in meters.

layoutRule.description: Layout spacing rule: FixedDistance or Number.
